description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Puttalam District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with the postponement and rescheduling of local authority elections in the Puttalam Administrative District. It contains a notice of poll under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, announcing that elections originally scheduled for March 9, 2023, have been postponed to April 25, 2023, due to unexpected circumstances. The content includes the schedule of specific local authorities affected. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes, election scheduling, and announcements related to local government elections.
